body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Fuse unveiled the 'Powerslice' at 2011 CES Unveiled.
Powerslice was created to universally charge up to four electronics at the same time, using only one wire.
Check out these available hook ups: Micro USB, mini USB, iPod/iPhone, Samsung, LG. there's even a nifty built-in USB port.
Slices are sold separately, but prefer working together as a team. When slice forces combine they create one piece of technology.

<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Idea K. Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Dongkwan Kim, Ashley Gamin Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
